issue.title: Bug:[Smartswitch] framework docker does not send reply to the RebootStatus gnoi_client request causing reboot to delay for DPUs

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The framework docker does not respond to the rebootstatus api for gnoi_client command, causing the reboot to delay, the reboot api executes correctly, causing pre shutdown on DPU, but the rebootstatus does not work the same way.

### Steps to Reproduce

Execute reboot -d DPU0, check that the reboot_status Api call fails

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

reboot_status api call succeeds

resolution.title: [sysmgr] Support platform reboot status query via DBus during HALT reboot
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
To enable the SONiC Sysmgr to retrieve reboot status from the platform via DBus during a HALT reboot. In HALT scenarios, the standard reboot path is not taken, and containers like pmon and syncd are stopped early, making platform-side tracking of reboot status essential for accurate system state reflection.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**: 32907011
- Fixes: #22157

#### How I did it
- Introduced a new send_dbus_reboot_status_request() method in RebootBE to communicate reboot status via DBus.

- Updated HandleStatusRequest() to call this method if a HALT reboot is currently in progress.

- Added appropriate logging and error handling for DBus response failures.

- Ensured DBus integration only activates in HALT-specific flows, preserving existing behavior for other reboot types.
#### How to verify it

- Initiated a HALT reboot on the device using the GNOI client.

- Verified that the platform correctly receives and handles the DBus reboot status request.

- Confirmed that pmon and other containers are stopped and system correctly logs and reports the HALT reboot status.

- Tested fallback/error handling when DBus call fails or returns empty JSON.

```
$ date;docker exec gnmi gnoi_client -target <IP>:8080 -logtostderr -notls -module System -rpc Reboot -jsonin '{"method": 3, "message":"Test Halt"}';sleep 10;docker exec gnmi gnoi_client -target <IP>:8080 -logtostderr -notls -module System -rpc RebootStatus;sleep 60;docker exec gnmi gnoi_client -target <IP>:8080 -logtostderr -notls -module System -rpc RebootStatus;date
Mon May 19 <IPV6> PM UTC 2025
System Reboot
System RebootStatus
{"active":true,"when":1747699033,"reason":"Test Halt","count":1,"method":3}
System RebootStatus
{"reason":"Halt reboot completed","count":1,"method":3}
Mon May 19 <IPV6> PM UTC 2025
```
